title: A Local Valuation Criterion for Quadratic-Permutation Interleaved Zadoff--Chu Sequences
summary: Berggren and Popović introduced quadratic-permutation-polynomial interleaved Zadoff--Chu sequences and, from exhaustive data, conjectured that all normalized QPP-interleaved Zadoff--Chu sequences are inequivalent to ordinary Zadoff--Chu sequences precisely for prime-power lengths $N=p^n$ with $p>3$ and $n>1$. We give an exact local arithmetic criterion.
